build_counter_agent: build a CounterAgent that counts unique utterances seen during ParlAI dialogue interactions
create_times_seen_metric: create a TimesSeenMetric to track the max number of times any example was seen
create_unique_metric: create a UniqueMetric to count the number of unique utterances in a Counter
